name: Nathanael
overview: Nathanael is introduced in Scripture as a sincere and discerning individual who initially questions whether anything good can come from Nazareth, yet responds to Philip's invitation to 'Come and see.' Jesus recognizes Nathanael's genuine character, calling him an Israelite without deceit, and reveals His supernatural knowledge by telling Nathanael He saw him under the fig tree before Philip's call. This encounter leads Nathanael to confess Jesus as the Son of God and King of Israel, marking his commitment as a disciple. Later, Nathanael is listed among Jesus' followers, confirming his role as one of the early disciples.
